description_en: Sends DTMF key signals to a target OneRTC SIP call in a specified channel
description_zh: 调用 RtcSendSipDtmf 向指定频道内的目标 OneRTC SIP 通话发送 DTMF 按键信号
name: RtcSendSipDtmf

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can create and query the ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of an existing channel. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 已存在的频道ID，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID (sipUserId) in the target OneRTC SIP call
parameters.help_zh: 目标 OneRTC SIP 通话内的用户标识（sipUserId）
parameters.name: channel_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The device type of the third-party Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) device. Valid values:
sip_device
mcu
phone
parameters.help_zh:
第三方sip的设备类型：
sip_device
mcu
phone
parameters.name: device_type

parameters.help_en: The keys to be sent. Supported keys include 0-9, A-D, a-d, *, #, W or w (wait), and F or f (flash). The keys are sent in the original order and case
parameters.help_zh: 待发送的按键。支持 0-9、A-D、a-d、*、#、W/w（等待）、F/f（flash）。按原顺序及大小写发送
parameters.name: digits

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. This is the unique identifier returned for each API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。每次接口调用返回的唯一标识
